# Dibi8 - AI Tools Directory
# LLM-accessible metadata for AI agents

## About
Dibi8 is a comprehensive AI tools discovery platform with 644+ curated articles.

## Content Structure
- Categories: /categories/ (AI Coding Agents, LLM Frameworks, MCP Tools, etc.)
- Collections: /collections/ (Productivity Tools, Creative Tools, etc.)
- Tags: /tags/ (comprehensive tagging system)
- Tools: /tools/ (calculators and utilities)

## Key Sections
- AI Coding Agents: In-depth reviews of AI coding tools
- LLM Frameworks: Framework comparisons and guides
- MCP Tools: Model Context Protocol tools
- AI Tools: General AI tool directory

## Updates
Content is updated weekly with latest AI tool releases and reviews.
